reviews.body: The pageSize=1 fix looks reasonable, and the HTTP-level tests cover the intended behavior. The reported lint failures are outside the pagination changes, but required checks still need to pass before merging. Please investigate the failing check.

comments.body: Thanks for looking into it. The two contextcheck findings (`ConvertTextToSQL` / `FixSQL` in `pkg/core/handler/search/search.go`) are pre-existing: both methods in `pkg/core/manager/ai/search.go` already call `client.Generate(context.Background(), ...)` on main, and this PR doesn't touch them. The new HTTP tests just make the linter walk that path. Fixing it means adding a `context.Context` parameter to both methods, which changes their API, so I'd rather keep that out of this pageSize=1 fix. Happy to open a separate PR for the context propagation if you'd like.
